cases.name: same_notes_under_alternate_root_and_paths
cases.classification_note: The immutable inputs and nullifiers are unchanged. A new expected root and proof are required.

cases.name: mixed_binding_and_nullifier_keys
cases.classification_note: The committed binding uses the original key while the witness and public nullifier use different retained authorities.

cases.name: detached_nullifier_commitment_message_byte_143
cases.classification_note: Membership and note hashing remain valid for the real hidden commitment. Only the independently computed public nullifier uses a changed commitment byte.

cases.name: detached_nullifier_commitment_message_byte_144
cases.classification_note: Membership and note hashing remain valid for the real hidden commitment. Only the independently computed public nullifier uses a changed commitment byte.

cases.name: output_secret_binding_remains_opaque_committed_bytes
cases.classification_note: This component derives only the two input bindings. Output authority and encryption policy remain outside the relation.

cases.name: new_key_binding_creates_a_different_note
cases.classification_note: The immutable owner bytes, commitment and nullifier change. This does not authorize an old note or reset its identity.

cases.name: zero_byte_key_preimages_have_no_authorization_claim
cases.classification_note: Only exact byte preimage binding is enforced. No signing key, valid signature or key generation provenance is established.

cases.name: output_owner_binding_remains_opaque_committed_bytes
cases.classification_note: Only the two input owner bindings have constrained preimages in this component.

cases.name: truncated_key_hash_as_owner
cases.classification_note: Genuine SHA3-512 of 2591 bytes is not the required hash of the full 2592 byte encoding.

cases.name: extra_framed_key_hash_as_owner
cases.classification_note: The existing owner hash is unframed, without a length prefix.

cases.name: chain_prefixed_key_hash_as_owner
cases.classification_note: The frozen owner preimage has no implicit chain field.

cases.name: domain_prefixed_key_hash_as_owner
cases.classification_note: A new domain would change the existing immutable owner identity.

cases.name: shake256_key_hash_as_owner
cases.classification_note: A valid SHAKE256 output is a different required computation from SHA3-512 owner binding.
